installCommand: mkdir -p $HOME/bin && curl -fsSL https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/releases/download/v10.33.0/pnpm-linux-x64 -o $HOME/bin/pnpm && chmod +x $HOME/bin/pnpm && export PATH="$HOME/bin:$PATH" && pnpm --version && COREPACK_ENABLE_STRICT=0 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
buildCommand: export PATH="$HOME/bin:$PATH" && pnpm --filter @meso.ai/types run build && pnpm --filter @meso.ai/ui run build && pnpm --filter @meso/demo run build
